messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High error rate detected for rerank pipeline (service: rerank-batch, region: us-west). Error spikes started ~09:20 UTC. Pager sent to #incidents and current oncall. :rotating_light:
carol (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Starting triage—checking recent deploys + consumer lag. Can someone confirm customer impact?
sara (support): Seeing ~40 customer requests failing with 500s in the last 10m, ~12 customers reported visible errors in dashboards. Affected: search/rerank flows only. Putting customer list in the incident doc.
deploy-bot: Deployed rerank-batch v2 (commit abc123) to us-west at 09:18 UTC to address throughput improvements.
jess (ml-eng): adding detail: our reranker batch endpoint is throwing vector length validation errors. Initial log sample below. I suspect a data shaping change in the preprocessor or a padding regression in the new runtime.
```
Error: vector_size_mismatch: expected=1536 got=0
  at /app/serve/rerank/batch_handler.py:214
  input_shape: (0,1536)
  batch_id: 9876
  request_id: b2f9...
```
carol (oncall): Good catch. If vectors are empty that's probably causing downstream OOMs/aborts. For immediate mitigation: switching traffic off the batch endpoint and routing new requests to the streaming rerank (rerank-stream) and a smaller fallback model. I'll do that now.
mike (sre): On it. I'm spinning a safe replica of rerank-stream and adding a router rule to route 100% of traffic away from rerank-batch in us-west. Also increasing consumer timeouts to avoid cascading retries.
jess (ml-eng): Quick repro notes: running the preprocessor on the failing payloads locally reproduces the zeroed vectors when input contains truncated paging tokens (paging token length > 4096). Suspect the padding trim changed in the tokenizer upgrade in abc123.
```
# repro snippet
>>> tokens = tokenizer.encode_long(paging_token)
>>> len(tokens)
4097
>>> embed = embedder.embed(tokens)
>>> len(embed)
0  # <-- unexpected
```
carol (oncall): Hypothesis tracking (in-thread):
- H1: Tokenizer/packer change in abc123 causing truncation/pad edgecases -> zero-length vectors. (evidence: deploy-bot + jess repro)
- H2: Batch gateway bug: batching logic drops payloads with >4096 tokens, sending empty payload into model. (evidence: some batch logs show input_shape (0,1536)).
- H3: Downstream consumer (rerank scorer) regression mis-parsing serialized vectors leading to 'got=0' error.
mike (sre): Gathering infra logs now. Dumping NGINX + batch-queue logs for the 09:15-09:25 window. Paste of relevant lines: 
```
[09:19:21] batch-queue: dequeue batch_id=9876 size=1
[09:19:21] batch-queue: payload_size=0 bytes (expected>12288)
[09:19:21] rerank-batch: vector_len=0 model_infer_skip=true
[09:19:22] rerank-batch: error vector_size_mismatch
```
jess (ml-eng): Also adding model-side logs from the embedder runtime: 
```
[09:19:20] embedder: received input shape (1,0)
[09:19:20] embedder: preproc pad-mode=truncate_v2
[09:19:20] embedder: returning empty embedding on invalid input
```
sara (support): Customer impact — escalations: 6 high-priority enterprise customers experienced failed rerank results; we've opened support tickets and informed account leads. No data exfiltration reported. Latency spiked to 12s for streaming fallback but functional.
carol (oncall): Mitigation status: rerank-batch disabled in us-west; traffic routed to rerank-stream with fallback model; error rate dropped from 18% -> 0.9% in 8 minutes. Notifying product and SRE to prepare RCA.
mike (sre): Rolling back abc123 to prior tag (commit zyx987) in canary to test if deploy caused issues. Patch rolled to canary at 09:40, monitoring.
jess (ml-eng): Note: abc123 included tokenizer upgrade and an embedder runtime tweak to 'truncate_v2'. If rollback fixes it, root cause likely H1. If not, need deeper batch-gateway traces.
carol (oncall): Can people drop any additional artifacts directly in this thread: request payload examples (sanitized), full batch gateway trace for batch_id 9876, and the embedder runtime log for 09:18-09:21. I'll collect timeline and write preliminary RCA doc.
mike (sre): Uploaded nginx and batch-queue logs to the incident bucket (s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-045/). Link: https://s3.redwood/internal/INC-2026-045/logs
jess (ml-eng): Uploaded sanitized request payloads and local repro script to the same bucket. Also creating a small unit test to catch zero-length embeddings for next CI. PR coming.
sara (support): Customer comms: sent interim notice to impacted customers summarizing fallback and ETA for RCA. Will follow up with final postmortem.
carol (oncall): Handing off to mike for post-mitigation monitoring and to jess for model-side investigation. I'm going offline in 40m but will be incident lead for postmortem writeup. Action items: 
- jess: root-cause patch + PR to revert tokenizer/truncate_v2 or add guard (owner: jess)
- mike: verify rollback telemetry and collect timeline for deploy and autoscaler activity (owner: mike)
- sara: consolidate customer impact list + messages (owner: sara)
- carol: draft RCA and timeline, include H1/H2/H3 and evidence (owner: carol)
Please append any more evidence to the S3 bucket and ping me if anything new appears.
mike (sre): Confirmed: canary rollback removed the zero-length vectors in canary logs. Rolling the rollback to us-west prod now.
jess (ml-eng): Preparing immediate guard: if embedder receives input length == 0 or tokens>4096, return standardized error upstream instead of empty vector. Will open hotfix PR and test.
carol (oncall): Thanks team — nice triage. I'll mark incident as mitigated once rollback completes and error rate normalizes for 30m. We'll run full RCA with timeline + root cause + preventive actions. Tagging incident id INC-2026-045.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> true; severity lowered. Add final notes to incident doc. :white_check_mark:
